title: Users, Groups & Identity
task: Read captures/passwd.txt and captures/group.txt. Write runner's UID as a single number in uid.txt. Resolve its primary GID to a group name and write that exact name in primary-group.txt.
hints: The fixture is in captures. Field 1 is the exact account name.
Use awk -F: and compare field 1 with runner. Its UID is field 3.
Take field 4 from the exact account. Find the group with that value in field 3 of captures/group.txt.

checks.label: The report identifies the exact runner UID
checks.feedback: Use an exact account match because runner-old has a different UID.

checks.label: The report names the primary group
checks.feedback: Join the account GID to group field 3. The supplementary list points to a different group.

demo.explanation: These are the UID and primary GID from an example account capture.
The name comes from matching the GID, even when the member list is empty.
